fieldData.title: What if I need to cancel my participation in the event?
fieldData.body:
Should you no longer be able to attend, we do allow qualified substitutes to attend in your place. Please notify your Operations Director to assist with this process. Should a substitute not be available, a cancellation fee will apply. For cancellations occurring 30 to 60 days in advance of the event, the fee is $500,and for cancellations occurring less than 30 days from the event, the fee is$1,495.

‍

‍
fieldData.name: Static - Delegate FAQ 11

fieldData.title: Are continuing education credits provided?
fieldData.body:
Yes, for many of our events, continuing education credits are available. Credit types include CLE, CPE, HRCI, and SHRM. Please reach out to your Operations Director for further information about what is available for each event.

‍
fieldData.name: Static - Delegate FAQ 10

fieldData.title: Are guests able to participate in the scheduled activities?
fieldData.body: Guests are permitted the Monday night dinner function during the official event. All other event functions are restricted to event attendees only.
fieldData.name: Static - Delegate FAQ 9

fieldData.title: What is the dress code for the event?
fieldData.body: The dress code is described as "business casual". We encourage a casual, comfortable atmosphere at all events.
fieldData.name: Static - Delegate FAQ 8

fieldData.title: Am I required to participate in business meetings?
fieldData.body: Yes. To optimize your event experience, all attendees are required to participate in all program activities, including business meetings with industry experts. These meetings are strategically scheduled throughout the three-day event and do not conflict with conference sessions or networking opportunities.
fieldData.name: Static - Delegate FAQ 7

fieldData.title: How do I create my personal itinerary?
fieldData.body:
Approximately three weeks in advance of the event, your Operations Director will notify you that you can begin building your itinerary in the Hub. You will have the opportunity to select the Sessions and Think Tanks that you would like to attend. You will also be asked to identify your business meeting preferences by selecting and ranking the organizations that you would be interested in meeting with onsite.

‍
fieldData.name: Static - Delegate FAQ 6

fieldData.title: If I am looking to extend my stay, what is the process?
fieldData.body:
If you wish to extend your stay, we can book additional nights at our corporate rate, subject to availability. Simply enter your intended arrival and departure dates on the "Book Hotel" page by the travel details deadline.

 

The discounted corporate rate is available for up to three days before and after the event. Payment for any additional nights will be billed directly by the hotel upon check-out. For more information, visit the Destination Information page.
fieldData.name: Static - Delegate FAQ 5

fieldData.title: How do I know if my reservation has been booked at the hotel?
fieldData.body: Once you submit your travel details through the Book Hotel page of your Hub, your reservation will be booked by your Operations Director, and no further action is required. Your hotel confirmation number will be made available approximately one week prior to the event.
fieldData.name: Static - Delegate FAQ 4

fieldData.title: Is airfare/transportation provided to/from the hotel?
fieldData.body: No, you are responsible for coordinating your own transportation to/from the event hotel.
fieldData.name: Static - Delegate FAQ 3

fieldData.title: What is included in my participation?
fieldData.body: Your registration includes accommodation for up to two nights at the hotel (unless otherwise outlined on your registration form), all organized group meals, event materials, and full access to the program.
fieldData.name: Static - Delegate FAQ 2

fieldData.title: What are my participation requirements?
fieldData.body: You are required to complete the following three tasks prior to the event: 1) Complete Your Attendee Profile; 2) Submit Hotel Reservation/Travel Details; and 3) Create Your Itinerary.
fieldData.name: Static - Delegate FAQ 1
